decisions.reason: As a 2023 add-on closely related to the established portfolio, its market potential is still uncertain and the option value of keeping it available for long-cycle infrastructure customers likely exceeds the limited cost of continuing it another year.
This web-based dimensioning tool is inexpensive to keep on the market, fits the firm's digitalization direction, and after only one year there is too little evidence to justify abandoning the option.

Because this 2023 fouling-detection system builds on existing engineering and product capabilities and customer adoption in municipal and utility markets usually takes time, management would preserve the option until more value-revealing results emerge.
